_comment: GOLDEN 2026-07-29 — full 305-station GPS+Galileo, 30 s, 30 epochs, COLD at 00:00:00 GPS,
DOY-129 (2024-05-08), in the WL-1-OFF posture.
This is the golden BASELINE, not the as-requested all-on arm.  Reason, measured on the
50-station pair in runs/golden_0729/{net50, net50_wl1off} this session:
epochs 1-10  bit-identical across arms (WL-1 arms at min_arc_epochs = 10, so it cannot
act earlier — this is the A/B's own validity check)
epochs 11-31 means, WL-1 ON vs OFF:
D5 innovation flags/ep   158.4 vs  45.6   (3.48x)
post-fit sigma0_code       6.03 vs  3.96   (1.52x)
robust clock spread     10.250 vs 8.764 m  (1.17x)
worst-sat deviation     22.062 vs 18.202 m (1.21x)
slip refloats/ep         205.0 vs  97.7   (2.10x)
With WL-1 OFF the clock spread keeps CONVERGING (9.80 -> 8.34 m over the run); with it ON
convergence is arrested at epoch 11 and ends worse than epoch 10 (9.13 -> 9.97 m).
No integers are involved: fix_enable / wl_inject_enable / lane_carry were OFF in BOTH arms.
The harm comes from the MW-seeded wide-lane FLOAT rows themselves (4710 folded, mean
R = 0.0319 cyc^2, sigma ~ 0.179 cyc).  The MW observable is CODE-derived, so folding it on
the Card-4 global chord basis injects code-scale error into a phase-precision carry, and the
D5 innovation gate then tears the carry down — 0 of 3649 re-taps had a raw phase step.
This EXTENDS the standing do-not-arm finding, which covered only the integer tiers.
The EWL/UWL DECISION tiers stay ON: they fold nothing (ewl_fold_rows default false) and are
the telemetry the MW AR question needs.  Keeping ewl_enable also holds ewl_carry_exclude
fixed, so carry membership matches the 50-station pair.
eigen_threads / parallel_max_threads 12: the two mwwl_cond posture-probe runs are still
live on this box but were only drawing ~18% total CPU when this launched.
